blocks.text: Aiko Melendez and Onemig Bondoc are set to walk down the aisle as they revealed their engagement, about eight months after making their romance official. Bondoc popped the question to Melendez while they were visiting the tomb of the actress’ late father, Jimi Melendez, as seen in the actor’s vlog on his YouTube channel on Tuesday, Oct. 6. During their visit, Melendez turned emotional as she recalled her memories with her dad. She also said that Bondoc was the first man she brought to the grave of her father.
